description: Experience contract for Command Center, the Director Swarm instrument. The board is the team's runtime surface and runs unattended in a room, so these specs were authored ahead of implementation to fix the honesty obligations before pixels harden around them. Every surface inherits four rules: no figure appears without the qualifier that makes it honest, no unreadable source is ever allowed to look healthy, no surface offers a control the scenario has no right to perform, and a room never renders blank. Claims remain aspirational until their named machine check exists; the pixel-based BAS suite separately proves that room scenes are nonblank, while experience-manager does not yet promote the render-nonblank claim type.
